## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and linting rules of this project (`ruff check .` passes).
- [ ] I have formatted my code (`ruff format .`).
- [ ] I have run tests locally (`QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest -q --forked`) and they all pass.
- [ ] If contributing new artwork / skins:
  - [ ] Packaged as a `.zip` containing a single animated `.gif` in `mycat/chars/`
  - [ ] Transparent background, <= 300x500 px, first frame is resting idle pose
  - [ ] I verify that this is original artwork created by me.
- [ ] I have updated documentation / README / CHANGELOG where appropriate.
